fomod.Name: Champion's Reforge
fomod.Author: synthalorian
fomod.Description: A commission for Adrianne Avenicci: pick a side, recover stolen forging notes, and wear a champion's harness that tempers with every matching piece. Upgrades the Civil War Champions armor (Anniversary Edition) at runtime if you own it. Unvoiced dialogue. No SKSE, no hard DLC/CC master. Early beta.
